character: Road course combining a stretch of Daytona's steep NASCAR oval banking with a technical infield section. The International Horseshoe and the Le Mans Chicane (formerly the 'Bus Stop') are the defining infield features; banking exit speed carries into the tri-oval.
sources: https://www.nascar.com/news-media/2020/08/12/daytona-road-course-turn-by-turn-analysis/ ; https://www.imsa.com/news/2022/01/28/chicanes-at-daytona-le-mans-renamed-in-symbol-of-unity/ — International Horseshoe / Le Mans Chicane (formerly "Bus Stop") verified

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: infield corner off the oval banking
corners.technique: Brake hard from banking speed, late apex
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance after carrying speed off the banking

corners.name: International Horseshoe
corners.type: flat, sweeping right-hander down to 1st gear
corners.technique: Patient trail brake, low speed, precise placement
corners.trap: Braking too late and missing the tight apex

corners.name: Le Mans Chicane
corners.technique: Hard, precise braking, smooth direction change through the three-legged chicane
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running out of track on exit

corners.name: Oval banking rejoin
corners.type: high-speed merge back onto the tri-oval banking
corners.technique: Commit smoothly, use the banking to carry speed
corners.trap: Hesitating on the merge costs significant time on the run to the line
